name: process_step_notify_policy
label: Notification Strategy Table for Process Steps
description: The process step reference notification strategy table is used for related queries related to the process, such as reporting scenarios.

fields.name: process_step_uuid
fields.description: Workflow step UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: notify_policy_id
fields.description: Notification strategy ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_step_uuid field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_notify_policy_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the notify_policy_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
